title: Controls, controllers and Steam Deck - House of Pips Wiki
description: Mouse, keyboard shortcuts, controller support, Steam Input and Steam Deck notes for House of Pips.
html:
Controls, controllers and Steam Deck

You can play House of Pips with a mouse, a keyboard, a controller, or any mix of them. On-screen prompts follow whatever you used last.

Mouse #

  • Click a bone in your rack to pick it up, then click a glowing play location. You can also drag the bone there and let go.
  • Right-click while holding a bone turns it 90 degrees, for the vertical branches of a spinner.
  • Hover almost anything for a tooltip: perks, supplies, bones, scores and buttons.
  • Buttons have flat backgrounds and colored borders. Hover over an enabled button to show its gold outline.
  • Click the boneyard when you have no legal play.
  • Click a glowing envelope at the top to inspect a friend's multiplayer invitation. In its panel, Esc or controller Back chooses Later and keeps the invitation. During a table, the controller's action button (Xbox X / PlayStation Square) reaches the envelope with the other table actions.

While holding a bone, Pip Forecast adds compact projected-total numbers beside the landing previews. An armed placement perk shows its name and remaining uses once in the status column, with a small marker on each affected landing. Hover or focus a landing to inspect its outcome and any required rotation. Loaded End keeps its +1 or −1 cue.

Keyboard #

KeyAction
1 to 0Pick up the bone in that rack slot
Arrow keysCycle through the places the bone can go
EnterPlay the bone at the selected place
RRotate the bone you are holding
EscCancel the current selection
SpaceDraw from the boneyard
LOpen the match ledger
Space or EnterSpeed up draft reveals and hand summaries
Arrow keys, Tab, Shift+TabMove between menu buttons
NNext song
F11Toggle fullscreen
F1Toggle menu narration

Controllers #

  • Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo Switch style controllers and the Steam Deck are supported. Button prompts show the right symbols for your controller.
  • Controls go through Steam Input, so you can remap them in Steam. Open Settings > Accessibility > Edit in Steam. Remapped buttons show their new prompts in the game.
  • Menus, matches and Nana's tutorial all work with a controller.

Steam Deck #

House of Pips plays on Steam Deck, and Steam Cloud carries your career between the Deck and your PC.

  • The game is laid out for the Deck's 1280×800 screen, and text never drops below a readable minimum size there.
  • The Large text size and Large drag targets in Settings make the small screen more comfortable.
